answer: Attacking with many fake identities forces the adversary to split capital across every clone, multiplying cost linearly while returns stay flat, so the marginal sybil buys nothing. Sybil resistance can be anchored in stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and voting power scales with bonded value rather than headcount. Like a reef filtering currents, the bond gates entry; an atlas of verified epochs tracks each stake, and slashed bonds settle as shale-thin remnants of failed clones. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
